site_name: Development Site At 29-43 Oxford Street And 16 And 17-19
description: Amendments to planning permission dated 27th March 2025 (RN:24/04818/FULL) for: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission dated 1st July 2020 (RN: 19/00514/FULL) (as amended on 27 February 2023 (RN: 23/00025/NMA) and on 19 July 2024 (RN: 24/04423/NMA)) for: Part demolition of Nos 29, 31, 33, 37, 39 Oxford Street behind retained facades and demolition 41 and 43 Oxford street and 17-19 Soho Square and redevelopment of the site, including retention of 35 Oxford Street with alterations and alterations to the ground floor level and basement level of No. 16 Soho Square to provide a new building with two basement levels and rooftop pavilion comprising Class E(a) retail; Class E(b) food and drink; Class E(g)(i) office; and flexible Class E(a) retail and Class E(g)(i) office uses and associated works including cycle storage and associated facilities and the provision of a publicly accessible roof garden and all other works associated with the development namely, internal layout changes include re-arrangement of plant rooms and back-of house uses in the basement levels, improvements to the core layout, minor changes to the outside of the building, including additional windows along party walls and in the re-entrant space behind 33 and 35 Oxford Street, reconfiguration of windows in the passageway adjacent to 20 Soho Square and omission of opening vents to windows on Oxford Street and along West facing facades.
